unitTitle: Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words

sections.title: Will — interrogative, form and use
sections.titleUz: Will — so'roq shakli, yasalishi va ishlatilishi

exercises.instructionUz: Will — so'roq shakli va qisqa javoblar.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ JADVALI:

  Will I go?        Will we go?
  Will you go?      Will you go?
  Will he go?       Will they go?
  Will she go?
  Will it go?

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Will you/he, etc go out tonight?
     → Yes, I/you/he, etc WILL.
     → No,  I/you/he, etc WON'T.

KITOBDAGI FORM QOIDALARI:

  1) Kelasi zamonning TASDIQ shaklini
     WILL + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI bilan yasaymiz.
        I'LL SEE you tomorrow.

  2) SO'ROQ shaklini
     WILL + KISHILIK OLMOSHI + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        WILL YOU COME tomorrow?

  3) INKOR shaklini
     WON'T + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI bilan yasaymiz.
        I WON'T SEE Judy.

UCHALA QOIDADA HAM BIR XIL SO'Z:
  'BASE FORM OF THE VERB' = fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
     see, come, go — 'saw', 'came', 'went' EMAS.

DIQQAT — PAST SIMPLE BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  past simple so'roq:  DID you come?
  future simple so'roq: WILL you come?
  Ikkalasida ham fe'l ASOSIY shaklda — bu umumiy qoida.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  'will' ni BASHORAT qilish uchun ishlatamiz.
     I think HE'LL COME tomorrow.

VAQT IBORALARI (will bilan ishlatiladi):
  after            keyin
  tomorrow         ertaga
  next week        keyingi hafta
  next year        keyingi yil
  next month       keyingi oy
  tonight          bugun kechqurun
  soon             tez orada

SOLISHTIRING — 42-BETDAGI PAST SIMPLE IBORALARI:
  O'TGAN:  yesterday, last week, ... ago, in 1964
  KELASI:  tomorrow, next week, tonight, soon
  Vaqt iborasi zamonni ANIQLAB beradi.

points.en: Will I go? Will you go? Will he go? Will she go? Will it go? Will we go? Will they go?
points.noteUz:
SO'ROQda 'will' gap boshiga chiqadi.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil.

points.en: Will you/he, etc go out tonight? — Yes, I/you/he, etc will. No, I/you/he, etc won't.
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javobda 'will/won't' takrorlanadi,
asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
'go out' = tashqariga chiqmoq (sayr, ko'ngilochar).

points.en: We form the affirmative of the future simple with will + base form of the verb. I'll see you tomorrow.
points.uz: Kelasi zamonning tasdiq shaklini will + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.

points.en: We form the interrogative with will + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Will you come tomorrow?
points.uz: So'roqni will + kishilik olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.

points.en: We form the negative with won't + base form of the verb. I won't see Judy.
points.uz: Inkorni won't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.

points.en: We use will to make predictions. I think he'll come tomorrow.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI USE qoidasi.
'I think' — bashorat so'zi.

points.en: Time Expressions: after, tomorrow, next week/year/month, tonight, soon, etc.
points.uz: Vaqt iboralari: keyin, ertaga, keyingi hafta/yil/oy, bugun kechqurun, tez orada.
points.noteUz:
Bu so'zlar KELASI zamonni bildiradi.
42-betdagi past simple iboralari bilan solishtiring.

exercises.instructionEn: Linking Words: and, because, but, until, when
exercises.instructionUz: Bog'lovchilar: and, because, but, until, when
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  Bog'lovchilarni gaplarni BIRLAShTIRISH uchun ishlatamiz.

BESH BOG'LOVCHI VA KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  AND — qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shadi
     Tony worked hard AND became famous.
     (Toni ko'p ishladi va mashhur bo'ldi.)

  BECAUSE — SABABNI ko'rsatadi
     Mary left early BECAUSE she wanted to catch the bus.
     (Meri erta ketdi, chunki avtobusga yetib olmoqchi edi.)

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIKNI ko'rsatadi
     Bob had a lot of money BUT he lost it all.
     (Bobda ko'p pul bor edi, lekin hammasini yo'qotdi.)

  UNTIL — harakatning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi
     She continued travelling UNTIL the day she died.
     (U vafot etgan kunigacha sayohat qilishda davom etdi.)

  WHEN — VAQTNI ko'rsatadi
     I learned to play tennis WHEN I was five.
     (Besh yoshimda tennis o'ynashni o'rgandim.)

QAY BIRINI TANLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  Ikkinchi gap SABABNI aytadimi?      → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi gap QARAMA-QARShIMI?       → BUT
  Ikkinchi gap QACHONligini aytadimi? → WHEN
  Birinchi harakat QACHONGACHA davom etdi? → UNTIL
  Shunchaki QO'ShIMCHA ma'lumotmi?    → AND

DIQQAT — 'BUT' OLDIDAN VERGUL:
  Bob had a lot of money, BUT he lost it all.
  ('and' oldidan odatda vergul qo'yilmaydi.)

DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' FARQI:
  ...BECAUSE... → SABAB keladi
     He was tired BECAUSE he worked hard.
  ...SO...      → NATIJA keladi
     He worked hard, SO he was tired.
  Ma'no bir xil, tartib teskari.

DIQQAT — 'UNTIL' va 'WHEN' FARQI:
  UNTIL — harakat O'ShA PAYTGACHA davom etadi
     She travelled until she died. (o'lgunicha sayohat qildi)
  WHEN  — harakat O'ShA PAYTDA bo'ladi
     She travelled when she was young. (yosh paytida)

BOG'LOVCHI GAP BOSHIDA HAM KELISHI MUMKIN:
  WHEN I was five, I learned to play tennis.
  BECAUSE she wanted to catch the bus, Mary left early.
  Bunda o'rtaga VERGUL qo'yiladi.
  ('and' va 'but' gap boshida kelmaydi.)

points.en: We use linking words to join sentences.
Tony worked hard and became famous.
points.uz: Toni ko'p ishladi va mashhur bo'ldi.
points.noteUz:
AND — qo'shimcha ma'lumot.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('Tony') takrorlanmagan —
bir xil ega bo'lsa tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi.

points.en: Mary left early because she wanted to catch the bus.
points.uz: Meri erta ketdi, chunki avtobusga yetib olmoqchi edi.
points.noteUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'catch the bus' = avtobusga yetib olmoq.

points.en: Bob had a lot of money but he lost it all.
points.uz: Bobda ko'p pul bor edi, lekin hammasini yo'qotdi.
points.noteUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
lose → LOST (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'all' = hammasi.

points.en: She continued travelling until the day she died.
points.uz: U vafot etgan kunigacha sayohat qilishda davom etdi.
points.noteUz:
UNTIL — harakatning OXIRI.
'continue + -ing' shakli.
Coursebook 73-betdagi Motsart matnida ham shunday edi.

points.en: I learned to play tennis when I was five.
points.noteUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
'learn TO play' — 'learn' dan keyin 'to' + fe'l.
'play tennis' — sport oldidan 'the' YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the past simple of the verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N OLTI FE'L — TO'G'RI va NOTO'G'RI ARALASH.

AVVAL O'ZINGIZDAN SO'RANG:
  Bu fe'l TO'G'RImi (-ed oladi) yoki NOTO'G'RImi?

BU RO'YXATDAGI NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  do → did,  make → made,  go → went,
  buy → bought,  become → became

Qolgan 11 tasi TO'G'RI fe'l.

items.whyUz:
do → DID. Noto'g'ri fe'l.
DIQQAT: 'did' bir vaqtda yordamchi fe'l ham —
'Did you work?' dagi 'did' bilan bir xil so'z.
love → loved. TO'G'RI fe'l.

call → called. TO'G'RI fe'l.
-ed /d/ deb o'qiladi.

admire → admired. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'to admire' = qoyil qolmoq.

visit → visited. TO'G'RI fe'l.
DIQQAT: urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda (VI-sit) —
shuning uchun 't' IKKILANMAYDI.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi.

make → MADE. Noto'g'ri fe'l.
DIQQAT: oxiri 'e' bo'lsa ham 'maked' XATO.

listen → listened. TO'G'RI fe'l.
DIQQAT: 't' O'QILMAYDI — /ˈlɪsnd/.
care → cared. TO'G'RI fe'l.

go → WENT. Noto'g'ri fe'l.
Butunlay boshqa so'z — 'goed' XATO.

invite → invited. TO'G'RI fe'l.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
appear → appeared. TO'G'RI fe'l.

buy → BOUGHT. Noto'g'ri fe'l.
DIQQAT: 'y' bor, lekin -IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI.
O'qilishi /bɔːt/.
discover → discovered. TO'G'RI fe'l.
complete → completed. TO'G'RI fe'l.

start → started. TO'G'RI fe'l.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

become → BECAME. Noto'g'ri fe'l.
42-betdagi Spelling qutisida namuna sifatida berilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the past simple of the verbs in the correct box, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shaklini to'g'ri qutiga yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
YIGIRMA FE'L, TO'RT QUTI:
  work, die, marry, write, watch, continue, say, bury,
  study, look, smile, play, get, tidy, receive, return,
  be, divorce, have, come

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  -ed qutisi:  worked,

TO'LIQ TAQSIMOT:

  -ED QUTISI (5 ta):
     worked, watched, looked, played, returned

  -D QUTISI (5 ta) — oxiri -E bo'lgan fe'llar:
     died, continued, smiled, received, divorced

  -IED QUTISI (4 ta) — undosh + Y:
     married, buried, studied, tidied

  IRREGULAR QUTISI (6 ta):
     wrote, said, got, was/were, had, came

DIQQAT — 'PLAY' NEGA -ED QUTISIDA?
  'play' oxiri 'y' bilan tugaydi, lekin 'y' oldida
  UNLI ('a') turibdi → -IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI.
  Faqat -ED qo'shiladi: played.
  Solishtiring: stUDy → studied (d — undosh).

DIQQAT — 'BE' NING IKKI SHAKLI:
  I/he/she/it → WAS
  you/we/they → WERE
  Bitta shakl emas — shuning uchun 'was/were' yoziladi.

items.whyUz: Oxiri 'k' — oddiy holat → + ED.
Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.
'r' undosh + 'y' → Y tushadi, -IED.

write → WROTE.
Oxiri 'e' bo'lsa ham 'writed' XATO.
Oxiri 'ch' → + ED.
Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.

say → SAID, o'qilishi /sed/.
DIQQAT: 'y' bor, lekin -IED ISHLAMAYDI.

'r' undosh + 'y' → -IED.
O'qilishi /ˈberid/.
'd' undosh + 'y' → -IED.

Oxiri 'k' → + ED.
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.

'a' — UNLI tovush, keyin 'y' →
-IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI, faqat + ED.
'plaied' XATO.
Bu — mashqning eng aldamchi bandi.

get → GOT.
'getted' XATO.

'd' undosh + 'y' → -IED.
'to tidy' = yig'ishtirmoq.

Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.
Yozilishi: 'i' dan OLDIN 'e'.
Oxiri 'n' → + ED.

be → WAS (I/he/she/it) yoki WERE (you/we/they).
Yagona fe'l — o'tgan zamonda IKKI shakli bor.
Oxiri 'e' → faqat + D.

have → HAD.
Oxiri 'e' bo'lsa ham 'haved' XATO.

come → CAME.
DIQQAT: 'become → became' bilan bir xil naqsh.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple. Which verbs are irregular?
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying. Qaysi fe'llar noto'g'ri?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Charles Dickens WAS a famous English writer. He was born
  in Portsmouth, England on 7th February, 1812. He WENT to
  school at the age of nine but he didn't finish his
  education. In 1824, he WORKED at a shoe polish factory
  and WENT back to school a year later. He TOOK a job as a
  legal clerk in 1827 and ENJOYED success as a reporter two
  years later.

  Dickens MARRIED Catherine Hogarth in 1836. He WROTE 'The
  Pickwick Papers' that same year. This book MADE him
  famous. He wrote many popular books and was considered to
  be England's finest writer.

  He DIVORCED his wife in 1858 and DIED on 9th June, 1870.
  They BURIED him in Westminster Abbey.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Charlz Dikkens mashhur ingliz yozuvchisi edi. U 1812-yil
  7-fevralda Angliyaning Portsmut shahrida tug'ilgan.
  To'qqiz yoshida maktabga bordi, lekin ta'limini
  tugatmadi. 1824-yilda poyabzal moyi fabrikasida ishladi
  va bir yildan keyin maktabga qaytdi. 1827-yilda huquqiy
  kotib bo'lib ishga kirdi va ikki yildan keyin muxbir
  sifatida muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
  Dikkens 1836-yilda Ketrin Xogartga uylandi. O'sha yili
  'Pikvik klubi yozuvlari' ni yozdi. Bu kitob uni mashhur
  qildi. U ko'plab mashhur kitoblar yozdi va Angliyaning
  eng zo'r yozuvchisi deb hisoblanardi.
  U 1858-yilda xotinidan ajrashdi va 1870-yil 9-iyunda
  vafot etdi. Uni Vestminster abbatligida dafn etishdi.


SAVOLGA JAVOB — QAYSI FE'LLAR NOTO'G'RI?
  be    → WAS    (1-band)
  go    → WENT   (2 va 4-bandlar)
  take  → TOOK   (5-band)
  write → WROTE  (8-band)
  make  → MADE   (9-band)

  Qolganlari TO'G'RI fe'l:
  worked, enjoyed, married, divorced, died, buried

DIQQAT — 'ENJOY' → 'ENJOYED':
  'y' oldida UNLI ('o') → -IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI.
  2-mashqdagi 'play → played' bilan bir xil.

DIQQAT — 'BURY' → 'BURIED':
  'y' oldida UNDOSH ('r') → -IED qo'shiladi.

CHARLZ DIKKENS HAQIDA:
  Ingliz adabiyotining eng mashhur yozuvchilaridan biri.
  Asarlari: 'Oliver Twist', 'David Copperfield',
  'A Christmas Carol', 'The Pickwick Papers'.
  Bolaligida kambag'allikni ko'rgan (fabrikada ishlagan) —
  shuning uchun asarlarida kambag'allar hayoti tasvirlangan.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a shoe polish factory = poyabzal moyi fabrikasi
  a legal clerk         = huquqiy kotib
  success               = muvaffaqiyat
  a reporter            = muxbir
  to be considered      = hisoblanmoq
  finest                = eng zo'r (fine ning ustun darajasi)
  an abbey              = abbatlik (katta cherkov)

items.textEn: 1  Charles Dickens ............ (be) a famous English writer.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS. NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
'Charles Dickens' BIRLIK → was.

items.textEn: 2  He ............ (go) to school at the age of nine ...
items.whyUz:
go → WENT. NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
'at the age of nine' = to'qqiz yoshida.

items.textEn: 3  In 1824, he ............ (work) at a shoe polish factory ...
items.whyUz:
work → worked. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'a shoe polish factory' = poyabzal moyi fabrikasi.
Dikkens 12 yoshida u yerda ishlagan — oilasi qashshoqlashgani uchun.

items.textEn: 4  ... and ............ (go) back to school a year later.
items.whyUz:
go → WENT. NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
'go back' = qaytmoq.
'a year later' = bir yildan keyin.

items.textEn: 5  He ............ (take) a job as a legal clerk in 1827 ...
items.whyUz:
take → TOOK. NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
'take a job' = ishga kirmoq.
'a legal clerk' = huquqiy kotib.

items.textEn: 6  ... and ............ (enjoy) success as a reporter two years later.
items.whyUz:
enjoy → ENJOYED. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'o' — UNLI tovush, keyin 'y' → -IED ISHLAMAYDI,
faqat + ED. 'enjoied' XATO.
'enjoy success' = muvaffaqiyatdan zavqlanmoq.

marry → MARRIED. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'r' undosh + 'y' → -IED.
6-band bilan SOLISHTIRING: enjoyed (unli+y) ↔ married (undosh+y).

items.textEn: 8  He ............ (write) 'The Pickwick Papers' that same year.
items.whyUz:
write → WROTE. NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
'that same year' = o'sha yilning o'zida (1836).
'The Pickwick Papers' — Dikkensning birinchi mashhur romani.

make → MADE. NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
'make somebody + sifat' = kimnidir ...qilmoq —
orada 'to' KERAK EMAS.
'made him famous' = uni mashhur qildi.

divorce → divorced. TO'G'RI fe'l.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'divorce' to'ldiruvchi bilan —
'divorced HIS WIFE' (xotinidan ajrashdi).

die → died. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'ON 9th June, 1870' — aniq sana → ON.

bury → BURIED. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'r' undosh + 'y' → -IED.
O'qilishi /ˈberid/.
'Westminster Abbey' — Londondagi mashhur abbatlik;
u yerda ko'plab mashhur inglizlar dafn etilgan.

groups.explanationUz: Fe'l oxiriga qarab to'rt guruhga bo'linadi.

groups.ruleUz: UNLI + Y  va  UNDOSH + Y — eng aldamchi joy

groups.explanationUz: Bu uch mashqda 12 ta noto'g'ri fe'l uchraydi.
Vaqt iborasi qaysi zamon kerakligini ko'rsatadi.

patterns.formula: Ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   /   Ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: I'll see you tomorrow. Will you come tomorrow? I won't see Judy.
patterns.exampleUz: Ertaga ko'rishamiz. Ertaga kelasanmi? Judini ko'rmayman.
patterns.explanationUz: Uchala shaklda ham fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

patterns.formula: WILL + ega + fe'l?  →  Yes, ... WILL. / No, ... WON'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Will you go out tonight? — Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
Tony worked hard and became famous. Bob had a lot of money but he lost it all.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni ko'p ishladi va mashhur bo'ldi. Bobda ko'p pul bor edi, lekin hammasini yo'qotdi.

patterns.exampleEn: Mary left early because she wanted to catch the bus.
patterns.exampleUz: Meri erta ketdi, chunki avtobusga yetib olmoqchi edi.

patterns.exampleEn: She continued travelling until the day she died. I learned to play tennis when I was five.
patterns.exampleUz: U vafot etgan kunigacha sayohat qildi. Besh yoshimda tennis o'ynashni o'rgandim.
patterns.explanationUz: UNTIL — harakatning OXIRI;  WHEN — harakat sodir bo'lgan PAYT.
